# [pixi](../index.md) global

Manage globally installed tools and their environments

--8<-- "docs/reference/cli/pixi/global_extender:description"

## Usage
```
pixi global <COMMAND>
```

## Subcommands
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [`add`](add.md) | Add dependencies to a global environment |
| [`edit`](edit.md) | Edit the global manifest file |
| [`exclude-newer`](exclude-newer/index.md) | Manage the `exclude-newer` configuration of the global manifest |
| [`install`](install.md) | Install packages globally and expose their executables. |
| [`uninstall`](uninstall.md) | Uninstall global environments. |
| [`remove`](remove.md) | Remove dependencies from a global environment |
| [`list`](list.md) | List all global environments, or when using `--environment` list all packages in a global environment. |
| [`sync`](sync.md) | Sync global manifest with installed environments |
| [`expose`](expose/index.md) | Interact with the exposure of binaries in the global environment |
| [`shortcut`](shortcut/index.md) | Manage application shortcuts of globally installed packages |
| [`update`](update.md) | Update global environments to the latest compatible package versions |
| [`tree`](tree.md) | Show the dependency tree of a global environment |


## Description
Manage globally installed tools and their environments.

Install packages on the user level. Into to the `$PIXI_HOME` directory, which defaults to `~/.pixi`.
